changes.title: Enable Submittable DocType and Fix Status Default
changes.description: Fixed validation errors when modifying Maintenance Request DocType

changes_made.reason: Enable submit workflow for Maintenance Request. Permissions were defined for submit action but DocType was not marked as submittable.
Fixed validation error: default value must be in the list of options. Changed to 'Submitted' which is the first logical status when a request is created.

changes.reason: Employees can submit their own maintenance requests
Admins have full control including amend and cancel
Unit Heads can approve/submit maintenance requests
Technicians can only read/write, not submit (for assignment workflow)
Supervisors can verify and submit maintenance requests

changes_made.reason: Removed system-managed timestamp fields (created_on, created_by, modified_on, modified_by) as Frappe manages these automatically

errors_fixed: ValidationError: Cannot set Assign Submit if not Submittable
ValidationError: Default value for status must be in the list of options
